output.scope_note: The paper studies ion hopping in β- and β"-alumina solid electrolytes with terahertz Kerr effect spectroscopy, but it reports no ionic conductivity values with numbers and units; the only activation energies (about 45 meV) refer to the TKE relaxation time, and the low-frequency conductivity is cited only qualitatively (>200 meV, ref. 49).
